'''Mar''' is a member of [[Matrim Cauthon]]'s [[Band of the Red Hand]].

== Appearance ==
He is tall and lanky with a rough face.

== Activities ==
He was captured by a [[Warder]] when he was scouting the area around [[Salidar]].
He fights with the Band against the [[Shadowspawn]] army razing [[Caemlyn]].
